description: Critical functions are not divided among different individuals to reduce the risk of malicious activity without collusion. This signal indicates that single individuals may have the ability to perform security-critical actions without oversight or checks.
applicability: Applicable to systems and processes where separation of duties is required to prevent fraud or error. Includes financial systems, privileged access management, change management, and security administration.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through role assignment analysis, workflow review, and assessment of dual-control requirements for critical functions.
